Christian, your three Bitaxe Gammas and the Power K. were delivered on October 26. The only thing still to ship on Shop···· is your Harlo B30.

I'm sorry it's past the October 30 date. The first US batch of B30s has started arriving at our warehouse hub. Orders ship oldest first, and yours is from July, so it goes out as soon as those units are checked in at our Tennessee warehouse. The tracking link comes to your email the moment it ships.

You can follow that batch here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
